changes: Request coarse alongside fine on Android31+; interpret approximate-only grants without claiming precision.
Stage Android29 background only after foreground success; Android30+ requires explicit educational/settings flow.
Background-only requests never silently escalate foreground.
compatibility: Existing factories preserved; unsafe implicit background batching is intentionally corrected.
remaining: Settings navigation is explicit; a background request by itself intentionally returns false/RequiresSettings or RequiresForeground.

changes: Refresh previously granted as well as denied states on lifecycle resume; key observers by requested event.
Suppress stale asynchronous observations by generation; local-network passive refresh invalidates certainty without probing.
compatibility: Mutable legacy status retained; manual assignments do not override actual OS observations.
remaining: SDK34 Robolectric resume revocation/disposal passed; physical-device one-time grants, OS lifecycle and process-recreation checks remain pending.
iOS has no definitive passive local-network query; resume reports Unknown, not a cached guaranteed grant.

## Classification
- **Finding:** PERM-004
- **Priority:** High
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-permissions/core`, `calf-permissions/location`, `calf-permissions/background-location`

- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-permissions/core/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/MutablePermissionState.android.kt:90-99`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-permissions/core/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/MutablePermissionState.android.kt#L90-L99) — `launchPermissionRequest`
- [`calf-permissions/core/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/MutableMultiplePermissionsState.android.kt:130-138`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-permissions/core/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/MutableMultiplePermissionsState.android.kt#L130-L138) — `launchMultiplePermissionRequest`
- [`calf-permissions/location/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/LocationPermissions.android.kt:5-21`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-permissions/location/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/LocationPermissions.android.kt#L5-L21) — `registerFineLocationPermission/registerCoarseLocationPermission`
- [`calf-permissions/background-location/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/BackgroundLocationPermissions.android.kt:5-12`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-permissions/background-location/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/BackgroundLocationPermissions.android.kt#L5-L12) — `registerBackgroundLocationPermission`
- [`docs/permissions.md:113-120,291-329`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/docs/permissions.md#L113-L120) — `location examples`

## Root cause
A logical permission maps to exactly one string; FineLocation alone requests only ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION. Bulk dispatch sends all strings together without separating background location from foreground permissions or checking prerequisites.

## Impact and preconditions
Android12+ requires requesting FINE together with COARSE for precise access; requesting fine alone may be ignored. Android11+ foreground and background location cannot be requested together; background requires an already-granted foreground path and settings-oriented UX. Common single-fine/sample bulk patterns do not implement these rules.

## Supporting evidence
- Source sends one native string for FineLocation and an unpartitioned array for all bulk permissions.
- Android platform guidance: https://developer.android.com/develop/sensors-and-location/location/permissions/runtime and /background.

## Recommended solution
Add a tested location request strategy (fine+coarse in one foreground step, then a separate background step with target-SDK-appropriate education/settings); or explicitly reject/document unsupported combinations until that API exists. Preserve approximate grants rather than treating coarse-only as total failure.

## Risks and compatibility
OS and target-SDK dependent; precise dialog/device behavior was not executed in this Linux audit. Never silently escalate a coarse-only request to precise/background access.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- API23,29,30,31,33+ with both current and legacy targetSdk: fine alone, coarse alone, fine+coarse, foreground+background.
- Accept approximate, deny precise, deny background and return from Settings.
- Verify manifest omissions and location services disabled are distinguished.

## Dependencies
- PERM-003

- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/issues/281
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/298

<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:PERM-006 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** PERM-006
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-permissions/core`
- **Estimated complexity:** M
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-permissions/core/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/permissions/PermissionsUtil.ios.kt:22-29,53-61`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-permissions/core/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/permissions/PermissionsUtil.ios.kt#L22-L29) — `PermissionLifecycleCheckerEffect/PermissionsLifecycleCheckerEffect`
- [`calf-permissions/core/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/PermissionsUtil.android.kt:29-36,60-68`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-permissions/core/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/permissions/PermissionsUtil.android.kt#L29-L36) — `PermissionLifecycleCheckerEffect/PermissionsLifecycleCheckerEffect`

## Root cause
ON_RESUME refresh is conditional on cached status not being Granted. The comment assumes revocations cause process restart; that is not a valid blanket guarantee across iOS permission types or notification settings.

## Impact and preconditions
When the app survives a settings change from granted to denied, the state remains granted until a later explicit request/recreation. Notification settings are an especially important iOS scenario. Cache status must not be treated as authorization enforcement.

## Supporting evidence
- Both platform observers explicitly guard refresh with status != Granted.
- Archived #313/#331 added iOS resume support; #411 later reports settings-return staleness, not proof of this exact grant-to-deny path.

## Recommended solution
Refresh all tracked permissions on resume, with lightweight per-type status queries and asynchronous generation ordering. Remove the process-restart assumption; avoid re-triggering Wi-Fi prompts while fixing refresh.

## Risks and compatibility
Unconditional refresh currently invokes the intrusive Wi-Fi status getter; fix PERM-013 or exempt side-effecting probes first. Revocation process behavior differs by OS and permission and needs devices.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Granted notification/camera/location toggled off in Settings then resume without process death.
- Denied-to-granted, one-time grant expiry, repeated resumes, batched permissions and lifecycle disposal.

## Dependencies
- PERM-013

## Historical context
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/issues/313
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/331
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/issues/411
